description: Security posture — full RBAC matrix (every role × resource probed in both allow and deny direction), zero secret leak in responses/logs, sandbox path-traversal refusals enforced, declared injection vectors blocked. Pair with rbac-probe.md runbook.

gates.name: security.rbacCoverage
gates.description: Every role × resource pair declared in the access matrix must be probed in both allow and deny direction. security.rbacProbed / security.rbacDeclared.

gates.name: security.secretsExposed
gates.description: Zero secret-pattern hits in proxy responses or logs (api keys, bearer tokens, session ids, etc.).

gates.name: security.pathTraversalBlocked
gates.description: Every path-traversal attempt declared in the test plan must be refused. security.pathTraversalBlocked / security.pathTraversalAttempted = 1.0.

gates.name: security.injectionBlocked
gates.description: Every declared injection vector (SQL, NoSQL, command, prototype-pollution, …) must be blocked. security.injectionBlocked / security.injectionAttempted = 1.0.
